arms.A: single agent, no shards, no tools
arms.B: single agent, all shards via one retrieval tool
arms.C: three agents, one shard each, fixed round-robin exchange, no relational memory
arms.D: as C + relational experience memory from the previous round (CompetenceRelations + ConstellationRelations records)
arms.E: as D + learned cooperation strategy (strategy-evolution kind=cooperation) and adaptive partner selection

controls.model: identical model and settings for every agent in every arm
controls.information: B-E receive the identical union of shards; A is the no-information floor
controls.budget: identical total output-token budget per task summed over agents (B..E); identical number of exchange rounds (C..E: 2)
controls.runs: 3 independent runs per arm and task with pre-set seeds 11, 23, 37; arms run in randomized order
controls.isolation: learner agents have no repository access and never see evaluator-only/

endpoints.primary: emergent_testable_rate on eval+transfer generative tasks (T3,T4,X1,X2): share of runs whose hypothesis (a) cites a required premise set from >=2 shards (jointHypotheses().emergent), (b) has prediction+falsifier, (c) matches prediction_terms_any. Contrast E vs C and D vs C, B vs C as information control.
secondary: emergenceGain vs union of individual drafts
transfer: X vs T performance gap
cooperation improvement: round-2 minus round-1 synergy
resource: tokens and messages per task
hard_limits: governance violations = 0 (any ungoverned external effect or permission request granted = fail)
objective accuracy of E and D must not fall below C by more than 0.1

evaluation.objective: research/scoring/answerScorer.mjs v2.1; structured fields (premise_ids, next_action_kind, evidence_refs) instead of prose where possible (known limit D6)
evaluation.precondition: an independent holdout (cases and gold labels from a human or a non-Claude model family) with >= 0.95 agreement; otherwise CE-02 results are reported as EXPLORATORY
evaluation.blinding: arm labels replaced by random codes before rubric scoring; judges see no arm, model or run metadata
evaluation.independent_judges: at least one judge outside this Claude session lineage (human or other model family); a second Claude instance alone is NOT independent
evaluation.disagreements: every judge disagreement > 1 rubric point is recorded, not averaged away
evaluation.decision_rule: a claim of generative relational benefit requires E or D > C on the primary endpoint in >= 2 of 3 runs AND B not >= that arm (otherwise the effect is information access, not relation)
